poem.content:
In crypto's dark past, a tragic tale unfold
Of cattle ranchers, who gambled with gold
Their private herds, traded on a virtual field
Where smart investors, with each punch, yield

Their fortunes rose, as the image took hold
A tuna of wealth, in waters yet untold
But beneath the surface, a drama did brew
As young traders, with wild hearts, took the view

Their vivid dreams, of cryptocurrency's might
 Led them to invest, with all their sight
But the market's punch, came with a bitter taste
Leaving them with regret, and a private waste

Their picture perfect, was now a tragic sight
Their cattle, once strong, now lost in the night
Their kit, once sharp, now dull and gray
As the truth dawned, they'd been led astray

In this post-apocalyptic, virtual land
Their animals, once tame, now ran amok, hand in hand
With the black market's, sinister, hidden sway
Their once bright future, now faded away

The smart money, had run, with every pace
Leaving the young, to face the dark, lonely space
Their tuna of wealth, now nothing but a distant dream
A tragic reminder, of their crypto scheme
